jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
At SolarWinds, we’re a people\-first company. Our purpose is to enrich the lives of the people we serve—including our employees, customers, shareholders, partners, and communities. Join us in our mission to help customers accelerate business transformation with simple, powerful, and secure solutions.
 



 The ideal candidate thrives in an innovative, fast\-paced environment and is collaborative, accountable, ready, and empathetic. We’re looking for individuals who believe they can accomplish more as a team and create lasting growth for themselves and others. We hire based on attitude, competency, and commitment. Solarians are ready to advance our world\-class solutions in a fast\-paced environment and accept the challenge to lead with purpose. If you’re looking to build your career with an exceptional team, you’ve come to the right place. Join SolarWinds and grow with us!
 


  
 
 Senior Product Manager \- Intelligent Events, Health, and SLOs
 



  

**Role Summary:** 




 This Senior Product Manager will own the strategy for how SolarWinds defines, measures, and communicates the reliability and operational health of customer systems.  The core focus is transforming raw observability data into actionable, intelligent events and proactive health scores, directly enabling customer Service Level Objective (SLO) management and incident reduction.  This role drives the product vision for event correlation and anomaly detection, ensuring our platform moves customers from reactive monitoring to proactive incident prevention.  Success will be measured by the adoption of SLO features, the reduction in alert volume for customers, and the quality of system health scoring.
 



  

**Core Responsibilities:** 




 Define the product strategy and roadmap for Service Level Indicators (SLIs) and Service Level Objectives (SLOs), ensuring seamless configuration, tracking, and reporting for our enterprise users.  Lead the development of the event management platform, focusing on advanced correlation, root cause analysis, and proprietary noise reduction techniques to combat alert fatigue.  Establish a unified, platform\-wide health and risk scoring model that synthesizes metrics, logs, and traces into a single, understandable view of system wellness.  Collaborate with machine learning and engineering teams to integrate AI\-driven anomaly detection and predictive alerting features for the proactive identification of impending issues.  Must be the voice of the Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) persona, translating industry best practices into powerful, simple\-to\-use product features.
 



  

**Required Qualifications:** 




 Deep domain expertise in AIOps, event management, and Service Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices, with specific experience in defining and launching SLO/SLI features.  Proven experience in product managing technical platforms that leverage data science, machine learning, or statistical models for event correlation and anomaly detection.  Strong working knowledge of how observability data (metrics, logs, traces) is used to calculate system health and drive automated workflows.  Must possess impeccable oral and written communications skills, exceptional leadership capabilities to drive cross\-functional alignment, and proven expertise in product strategy and product management fundamentals.  Demonstrated ability to deliver features that fundamentally improve a customer’s operational efficiency and reduce Mean Time to Repair (MTTR).
 



  
 



 SolarWinds is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. SolarWinds will consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, disability, veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.
 



 All applications are treated in accordance with the SolarWinds Privacy Notice: https://www.solarwinds.com/applicant\-privacy\-notice

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description:
**Role Overview**


We are seeking a skilled Data Engineer to design, build, and maintain scalable data platforms and pipelines across AWS and Azure. The role will support analytics, AI/ML, and business intelligence use cases using modern data technologies including Databricks, Snowflake, SageMaker, and Amazon Bedrock. The ideal candidate has strong cloud data engineering experience and collaborates closely with data scientists, analytics teams, and business stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities**

*Data Platform \& Pipeline Development*


Design, develop, and optimize scalable, secure, and reliable data pipelines using batch and streaming patterns.


Build and maintain ETL/ELT workflows ingesting data from structured and unstructured sources.


Implement data transformations and orchestration using Databricks (Spark), SQL, and Python.


Develop and maintain data models optimized for analytics and reporting.

*Cloud \& Data Architecture*


Implement data solutions on AWS and Azure leveraging native services.


Design and manage cloud storage solutions (e.g., S3, ADLS Gen2\).


Build cloud‑agnostic or hybrid architectures supporting multi‑cloud strategies when required.


Optimize performance, scalability, reliability, and cost across platforms.

*Analytics \& Data Warehousing*


Design and support Snowflake data warehouse solutions, including schema design, performance tuning, and cost management.


Enable self‑service analytics and BI use cases through curated, high‑quality datasets.


Partner with reporting and analytics teams to ensure data availability and accuracy.

*AI / ML \& Advanced Analytics Enablemen*t


Support ML workflows by preparing and engineering features for SageMaker and Amazon Bedrock use cases.


Collaborate with data scientists to operationalize ML models (MLOps integration).


Enable GenAI and advanced analytics workloads through secure, governed data access.

*Data Quality, Security \& Governance*


Implement data quality checks, monitoring, and validation frameworks.


Ensure compliance with security, privacy, and regulatory requirements.


Apply data governance standards including lineage, metadata management, and access controls.

*DevOps \& Automation*


Implement CI/CD pipelines for data solutions using infrastructure‑as‑code (Terraform, ARM, CloudFormation).


Automate deployments, monitoring, logging, and alerting.


Participate in on‑call or support rotations as needed.

*Collaboration \& Stakeholder Engagement*


Work closely with product owners, business stakeholders, architects, and analytics teams.


Translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.


Contribute to documentation, standards, and best practices across the data engineering team.

**Required Skills \& Experience**

**Technical Skills**


Strong experience with Python and SQL.


Hands‑on experience with Databricks (Apache Spark).


Proven experience building solutions on AWS and/or Azure.


Experience with Snowflake data warehouse.


Experience supporting ML or AI workloads using SageMaker and Amazon Bedrock (or equivalent services).


Knowledge of data integration tools, APIs, and message/streaming platforms.


Understanding of data modeling principles and analytics use cases.


Familiarity with DevOps concepts, CI/CD, and IaC.

**Soft Skills**


Strong problem‑solving and analytical skills.


Ability to communicate technical concepts to non‑technical audiences.


Collaborative mindset with experience working in agile teams.


Attention to detail with a focus on data accuracy and reliability.


Education Requirements


Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Data Science, or a related field.


Master’s degree is a plus but not required.

**Experience Requirements**


5\+ years of experience in data engineering or related roles.


3\+ years of hands‑on experience working with cloud data platforms (AWS and/or Azure).


Experience supporting enterprise‑scale data, analytics, and AI solutions.


Preferred Qualifications


Cloud certifications (AWS, Azure, Databricks, Snowflake).


Experience in healthcare, life sciences, finance, or other regulated industries.


Exposure to real‑time or streaming data architectures.


Experience with data governance, metadata tools, and privacy frameworks.

jobs.title: Bogie Bid Manager
jobs.description:
At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high\-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, 80,000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.

  



Could you be the full\-time Bogie Bid Manager we’re looking for?

 **Your future role**



Take on a new challenge and apply your expertise in bid management to a cutting\-edge field. You’ll work alongside a dynamic, collaborative, and innovative team.



You'll play a crucial role in delivering winning proposals that align with Alstom’s strategy and commitment to Quality, Cost, and Delivery Performance (QCDP). Day\-to\-day, you’ll work closely with cross\-functional teams across the business (such as Bid Managers, Platform teams, and sub\-system/product strategy owners), coordinate tender activities, and ensure compliance with Alstom’s rules and processes, and much more.



You’ll specifically take care of managing sub\-system tender budgets and ensuring the compliance of offered solutions with customer requirements, but also contribute to risk and opportunity reviews and support the transition from tender to project execution.



We’ll look to you for:


* Coordinating internal activities to identify and understand customer needs and promote Alstom’s solutions
* Managing the tender process, including compliance with applicable rules, ethics, safety, and quality standards
* Defining and consolidating Quality, Cost, and Delivery (QCD) commitments for the sub\-system
* Overseeing requirements analysis and managing interface with bid\-level teams
* Organizing risk reviews and ensuring mitigation plans are in place
* Maintaining traceability of tender documentation and supporting contract negotiations
* Contributing to lessons learned and leveraging insights for continuous improvement
  


  

**All about you**



We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:


* A Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field
* At least 7 years of experience with a strong understanding of Alstom’s processes
* Global knowledge of sub\-systems and an ability to challenge proposals to achieve optimal solutions
* Basic knowledge of offered products and systems
* Understanding of financial, contractual, and legal aspects related to tendering
* Strong team management and collaboration skills
* Excellent communication, reporting, and negotiation abilities
* A proactive mindset with a good sense of anticipation
  


  

**Things you’ll enjoy** Join us on a life\-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also:


* Enjoy stability, challenges, and a long\-term career free from repetitive daily routines
* Work with cutting\-edge standards for rail signalling
* Collaborate with diverse and supportive colleagues across functions
* Contribute to innovative and impactful projects
* Utilise our flexible and inclusive working environment
* Steer your career in whatever direction you choose, across functions and countries
* Benefit from our investment in your development through award\-winning learning programs
* Progress towards leadership roles within the organization
* Receive a fair and dynamic reward package, including comprehensive social coverage (life, medical, pension)

  




You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!

  



As a global business, we’re an equal\-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

  

  

**Job Segment:** Manager, Management

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer - II
jobs.description:
### **About the Team**



Want to be the engineer who turns our Voice AI platform from a product into a production\-grade solution inside a client's business? Then joining us as a Forward Deployed Engineer might be the perfect fit for you!



When enterprises trust our voicebot AI to handle thousands of live customer conversations daily, onboarding them right and keeping things running smoothly isn't optional — it's mission\-critical. Our FDE team is the technical backbone of every client relationship, responsible for taking clients from signed contract to successful production deployment and beyond.



We operate with a strong ownership mindset. Our team moves fast, communicates clearly, and treats every client deployment like a product launch. We work closely with Product, Infra, Biz and Platform Engineering to ensure what we learn in the field shapes how we build.



As a **Forward Deployed Engineer**, you'll work alongside a sharp, client\-obsessed team who thrive on solving real\-world problems at the intersection of Voice AI and enterprise operations.



We know how to party as hard as we work! When we’re not solving customer problems, you can find us discussing the latest tech trends, sharing our favorite books and games, or simply unwinding over a hot cup of chai.



If you want a role where no two days look the same and your work directly impacts how businesses talk to their customers, come join us!


### **About the Role**



As a **Forward Deployed Engineer** in our Voice AI team, you will be the primary technical owner for client deployments on our B2B voicebot platform. You'll work directly with clients to understand their requirements, configure and deploy voicebot solutions, build customisations, resolve production issues, and ensure ongoing success\- acting as the bridge between our platform's capabilities and the client's business needs.



If you're someone who loves owning outcomes end\-to\-end, this role is built for you.



### **What you will do**


* Own end\-to\-end client onboarding, from requirement gathering and solution design to platform configuration, UAT, and production go\-live
* Conduct technical discovery sessions to map client needs
* Design custom conversation flows and integration logic for clients
* Develop POCs and prototypes for development
* Troubleshoot and resolve production issues across the stack
* Build technical solutions to bridge gaps between our platform and client systems
* Stay updated with emerging tech cultures and identify the right opportunities to implement them
* Contribute to improving onboarding frameworks and FDE tooling
### **What you will need**


* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
* 2\-5 years of experience in software engineering or forward deployed engineering or a client\-facing technical delivery role in a B2B SaaS or AI product company
* Proficiency in Python and/or Go with hands\-on experience building and debugging technical systems
* Strong understanding of database systems (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB)

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


The Account Compliance teams is dedicated to making Amazon the safest and most trusted place to buy and sell. We sit at the forefront of global compliance, shaping how Amazon navigates complex regulatory landscapes across international markets. Our global first line of defense (1LoD) risk program protects our customers' interests while balancing risk management with exceptional customer experience.  

We are seeking an experienced Monitoring Risk Manager to join our Global 1LoD risk program, with a primary focus on 3P VAT programs. The role involves supporting the implementation of the VAT Monitoring program across EU and other regions, ensuring that Amazon controls are adequate, operating efficiently, and meeting requirements. This role sits at the intersection of tax compliance, risk detection, and product innovation, with direct visibility to senior leadership as we build more proactive, intelligence\-driven compliance capabilities  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Lead a VAT Monitoring program that performs continuous assessments of controls across Amazon, ensuring they are adequate and operating efficiently
* Conduct reviews of Amazon 3P VAT policies and requirements to identify gaps that require the implementation of new controls
* Review 1LoD VAT processes to identify additional controls to be added to our continuous monitoring program
* Work with Program, Tech, and BI teams to support the launch of monitoring mechanisms for existing VAT controls
* Deep dive into defects identified on VAT controls and support root cause analysis, risk assessment, and identification of remediation plans
* Own and maintain a program\-level issue register to track control defects, root causes, remediation plans, and workstream progress through to resolution
* Ensure remediation and treatment plans are kept current and aligned with the issue register, coordinating with control owners to drive closure
* Identify and document SOP alignment gaps surfaced through monitoring activity, working with relevant teams to resolve them
* Prepare and present detailed reports with findings from monitoring activity, providing updates to senior leadership at varying cadences (weekly, monthly, quarterly)
* Expand the Monitoring program into new areas or products, or where VAT requirements are being introduced
* Establish feedback loops with cross\-functional teams to ensure monitoring insights translate into concrete improvements to controls and detection logic

  

A day in the life  

You will be part of a team of risk and compliance professionals working to ensure Amazon's VAT controls are robust, well\-monitored, and continuously improving. On any given day, you might be reviewing control defects to identify root causes, coordinating with Tech and BI teams on new monitoring mechanisms, or preparing a report for senior leadership on the health of the VAT compliance program. You'll work across organizational boundaries—connecting with Tax, Product, and Operations teams—to make sure monitoring findings drive real change.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* 4\+ years of compliance program management, legal, governance, audit, risk/loss prevention, or equivalent experience
* Experience handling confidential information

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3\+ years of program requirements definition and data and metrics leveraging to drive improvements experience
* Experience with SQL and Excel
* Experience in 3P VAT programs (e.g., deemed reseller, DAC7, VAS)
* Experience leveraging data and technology to drive process improvements

 Join Barclays as a AI Product Owner. You will be collaborating with AI product owners and other technical teams involved in the product development process and utilise their knowledge of the bank’s technologies to enact the vision defined in the product roadmap. Person should be close to technology and demonstrate passion in adopting AI tooling to help simplify and automate processes within the bank.
   

  

**To Be Successful In This Role You Should Have**
* Provision of subject matter expertise to support the collaboration between the product owner and the technical side of product development.
* Support the development and implementation of the product strategy and vision defined in the product roadmap and communicate them with the relevant stakeholders and the development team.
* Collaboration with internal stakeholders to gather and prioritise product requirements and features based on business value and feasibility that are well defined, measurable and secure.
* Development and implementation of assessments to ensure continuous testing and improvement of product quality and performance.
* Monitoring of product performance to identify opportunities for optimisation that meets the banks performance standards.
* Stay abreast of the latest industry technology trends and technologies, to evaluate and adopt new approaches to improve product development and delivery.


**Some Other Highly Valued Skills Include**
* Collaboration with internal stakeholders to gather and prioritise product requirements and features based on business value and feasibility that are well defined, measurable and secure.
* Development and implementation of assessments to ensure continuous testing and improvement of product quality and performance.


 You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.
   

  

 The successful candidate will be based in Bengaluru.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 The purpose of a Product Owner is to maximize the value of the product by defining a clear product vision (are they setting the vision or would this align to ), managing authoring, refining and prioritizing the Product Backlog balancing trade\-offs across desirability, viability and feasibility – making sure the right thing is being ‘built’, and prioritising work based on business goals. They act as the primary liaison between stakeholders and delivery teams, ensuring the product meets user/customer needs and delivers optimal value. Product Owners are responsible for developing a roadmap and driving execution of their product area/sub\-journey, applying continuous improvement principles and techniques.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Ensure Product Alignment with Business Goals: Ensure that the product \& its features are aligned with broader objectives, driving value and contributing to the organization’s overall strategy. Utilisation of market research, analysis of customer feedback and monitoring of industry trends to identify new products, features or enhancements.
* Communicate Product Vision to Delivery Teams: Clearly articulate the product vision and goals to the delivery teams, ensuring they understand, align and are inspired to deliver the business value and purpose of each feature or user story.
* Create and Refine User Stories: Write clear, concise user stories with detailed acceptance criteria, refining them as needed to ensure the development team has all the necessary information to implement features successfully.
* Agile Events: Participate in key Agile events such as sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives to keep the team aligned and focused on delivering the product backlog.
* Managing the Product Backlog: Responsible for creating, maintaining, and prioritising the product backlog, ensuring the highest value features are delivered first, based on business needs, customer requirements and organisational impacts, balancing risk migration and future proofing against the product strategy.
* Act as the Voice of the Customer: Continuously gather feedback from customers and end\-users to understand their pain points and ensure that the product meets their needs and improves their overall experience.
* Acceptance Criteria Definition \& Management: Review and accept or reject work completed by the development team during sprints, ensuring that all delivered features meet the agreed\-upon acceptance criteria and deliver business value.
* Collaborate with Stakeholders: Work closely with stakeholders (e.g., customers, business leaders, and marketing teams) to gather requirements, define product goals, and ensure that the product vision aligns with business objectives.
* Monitor Product Performance and Iterate: Regularly assess product performance using KPIs and customer feedback, adjusting the product backlog and roadmap to improve functionality and meet evolving customer needs. Manage on\-going readiness and 'run' activities of live products including monitoring, governance and approvals.
* Risk and Control: Managing risk, including identification of potential risks, development of strategies to resolve or mitigate and escalate as necessary those risks, and alignment between the product management and control functions.

* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..

**Position Summary** 




  





 We are looking for an experienced and thoughtful Business Analyst to lead requirement discovery, product thinking, and business solution design for mobile applications, web platforms, admin portals, CMS systems, and internal digital tools.
 



 This role requires someone who can go beyond basic requirement gathering and think deeply about business problems, user journeys, system behavior, operational impact, scalability, and long\-term product value. The ideal candidate should be able to work effectively with leadership and product teams to translate high\-level business ideas into structured requirements, features, delivery phases, and measurable business outcomes.
 



 The candidate should bring strong communication, documentation, analytical thinking, product mindset, and stakeholder management skills. They should be comfortable challenging assumptions, asking the right questions, identifying gaps, and proposing better solutions instead of only documenting what is requested.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Facilitate requirement discovery sessions with business stakeholders, product owners, leadership teams, designers, developers, QA, and external vendors.
* Understand business goals, user needs, operational challenges, and technical constraints before converting them into product requirements.
* Prepare detailed business requirement documents, functional specifications, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, workflow diagrams, and use cases.
* Drive requirements for mobile apps, web applications, admin portals, CMS systems, dashboards, and internal business tools.
* Analyze user journeys and business workflows to identify gaps, risks, dependencies, edge cases, and improvement opportunities.
* Work closely with UI/UX teams to review Figma/Lucidchart designs and ensure the experience aligns with business objectives, usability needs, and user behavior.
* Collaborate with developers and architects to ensure requirements are technically clear, feasible, scalable, and implementation\-ready.
* Support QA teams by defining test scenarios, validating business rules, reviewing test coverage, and supporting UAT.
* Lead backlog refinement activities and collaborate with Product Owners and stakeholders to prioritize requirements based on business value, user impact, urgency, and technical dependencies.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies such as sprint planning, backlog grooming, stand\-ups, sprint reviews, demos, and retrospectives.
* Work with leadership to convert high\-level business ideas into structured product roadmaps, features, phases, and measurable outcomes.
* Coordinate with third\-party vendors, integration partners, and cross\-functional teams to ensure clarity, accountability, and timely delivery.
* Analyze user feedback, business data, usage patterns, and stakeholder inputs to recommend feature improvements.
* Identify process gaps and propose practical solutions that improve user experience, operational efficiency, system usability, and business outcomes.
* Provide guidance and support to junior BAs or team members through documentation reviews, requirement refinement, and knowledge sharing.
* Bring market awareness and ideas from other mobile/web applications, SaaS products, and digital platforms to improve product thinking.



  





**Skills \& Qualifications** 




  




* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field.
* MBA or equivalent business, product, or domain experience preferred, especially with exposure to Business, Strategy, Operations, Systems, or Product Management.
* 6\-9 years of experience as a Business Analyst, Product Analyst, Functional Consultant, or similar role.

The Role
   

  

 We are looking for a Business Analyst with a passion for transforming data into meaningful insights that guide strategic decisions. In this role, you'll dive into large data sets, visualize performance trends, and provide recommendations that influence business growth and efficiency. The position involves leveraging data analysis to optimise business processes, drive client account growth, and enhance operational efficiency.
   

  

 What you'll do
   

  

 Analyse data to uncover trends, anomalies, and business opportunities.
   

  

 Design data\-driven dashboards and reports to track key performance metrics and trends.
   

  

 Work closely with business stakeholders to understand and translate requirements into data solutions.
   

  

 Provide insights and recommendations to guide product, marketing, and operations strategies.
   

  

 Support forecasting, segmentation, and trend analysis across departments.
   

  

 Present insights clearly using visualizations and storytelling techniques for executive audiences.
   

  

 Analyse client payment data to identify opportunities for process optimisation, enhancing revenue realisation and minimising financial exposure associated with delayed payments.
   

  

 Contribute to increasing business from existing clients.
   

  

 Help reduce manual effort for teams involved in client management and finance operations, leading to savings in manhours.
   

  

 Monitor key business metrics.
   

  

 Highlight any concerns/red flags and optimise opportunities to senior management for business growth.
   

  

 Develop tailored strategies for accounts to expand their service use and drive high growth.
   

  

 Understand friction points stopping account growth.
   

  

 Work with Risk to open additional scope.
   

  

 What we are looking at
   

  

 25 years of experience in business or data analysis.
   

  

 Strong SQL skills and comfort working with large datasets.
   

  

 Ability to interpret complex data and translate it into business value.
   

  

 Strong communication skills for conveying insights to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
   

  

 Experience with Excel or Google Sheets for quick data analysis.
   

  

**Preferred Qualifications (Good To Have)**
 Experience in analytics within domains like fintech, SaaS, ecommerce, or marketing.
   

  

 Knowledge of statistical methods or predictive analytics is a bonus.
   

  

 Proficiency in at least one data visualization tool (e.g., Power BI, Tableau).

jobs.description:
New Street Technologies, established in 2017, is an award\-winning fintech company at the intersection of AI, blockchain, and regulated financial services. The company’s platform leverages Generative AI and multi\-agent architectures to transform how banks and financial institutions build, deploy, and operate business applications — reducing timelines from months to days. ISO 9001 \& ISO 27001 certified, New Street partners with leading banks and financial institutions across India, the GCC, and Southeast Asia.
 




  





**Industry Recognition** 





 \- Financial Times — 7th Fastest\-Growing Fintech, Asia Pacific (2024\)
 





 \- Deloitte Technology Fast 50 — High\-Growth Technology Company
 





 \- Aegis Graham Bell Award — Innovation in Banking \& Innovation in Blockchain
 





 \- World Fintech Awards 2025 — Most Impactful Partnership in Fintech
 





 \- Bharath Fintech Summit 2024 — Emerging Fintech Company of the Year
 





 \- Dun \& Bradstreet — Product Innovation with Blockchain Technology
 





 \- FICCI IBA — Best Emerging Technology Platform
 




  





**ABOUT THE ROLE** 




 You will be the bridge between business stakeholders, product managers and engineering — turning complex business needs into clear functional specifications, user stories and process flows. You will work across the MiFiX platform spanning lending, payments and financial services.
 



  





 This is a hands\-on, detail\-oriented role for someone who can sit in a stakeholder workshop in the morning, write a precise FSD in the afternoon, and walk an engineer through an API integration the next day. You make sure features land aligned with customer needs, regulatory requirements, and the realities of how lending actually works.
 



  





**WHAT YOU'LL DO** 




 •
 **Gather and analyse requirements** 
 — run workshops, requirement walkthroughs and UAT sessions; analyse domain workflows and compliance processes across FinTech, BFSI, lending, payments and AgriTech.
 



 •
 **Write the specs** 
 — BRDs, FSDs, user stories with acceptance criteria, and process documentation using standard templates, with traceability across features.
 



 •
 **Communicate visually** 
 — wireframes, screen mockups and process\-flow diagrams that engineering can build against without a re\-explanation meeting.
 



 •
 **Understand the integrations** 
 — read API documentation (bank APIs, middleware, third\-party: eKYC, credit bureau, payment gateway, e\-Sign); support API testing, validation and troubleshooting during integration.
 



 •
 **Bring AI into the workflow** 
 — use AI tools to work faster and contribute to AI\-driven features (intelligent document processing, credit\-scoring models, automated decision engines). A basic understanding of how AI/ML applies to financial products is expected.
 



 •
 **Support the product lifecycle** 
 — from ideation to release: market research, competitor analysis and data analysis to spot trends, gaps and improvement opportunities.
 



 •
 **Work Agile** 
 — sprint planning, backlog grooming, retrospectives; coordinate across engineering, QA, design and operations and keep stakeholders updated.
 



  





**WHAT YOU BRING** 




 • 3–5 years as a Business Analyst in FinTech, BFSI or Payments.
 



 • Strong grasp of lending workflows (loan origination, loan management, collections), remittances and digital payments.
 



 • Knowledge of core banking systems, payment infrastructure and compliance processes (RBI guidelines).
 



 • Hands\-on writing user stories, acceptance criteria, BRDs, FSDs and wireframes.
 



 • Proficiency with requirements and collaboration tools — JIRA, Confluence, Figma, Visio (or equivalents).
 



 • Basic technical knowledge of APIs (REST/JSON), data models and system integrations.
 



 • Comfort using AI assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot) for productivity and faster delivery.
 



 • Agile (Scrum/Kanban) experience; strong analytical, problem\-solving and communication skills.
 



 • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Finance or a related field; MBA/PGDM a plus.
 



  





**WHAT WOULD BE GREAT TO HAVE** 




 • Lending domain depth — loan origination, loan management, collections, credit assessment, and retail / agri lending products.
 



 • Regulatory knowledge — RBI guidelines, KYC/AML and data privacy (DPDPA).
 



 • Credit bureau integration experience (CIBIL, Equifax, CRIF) and credit\-rule configuration.
 



 • Exposure to eKYC (Aadhaar biometric), e\-Sign (Digio) and penny\-drop (Signzy) workflows.
 



 • Data analytics — advanced Excel, SQL, Power BI or Tableau.
 



 • Familiarity with Android app workflows and responsive web design principles.
 



 • Understanding of blockchain and its application in financial services.
